comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
This helmet can be produced at St. Petersburg. The recipe is found at the Attendant NPC (next to the Merchant Guild) and will only appear if you have equipped the Adept of Ages (17th Century-P.5) / Adept of Ages (18th Century-P.3) titles, or EX equipment with the Age effect (17th century) or Age effect (18th century) effects.

Recipe:

Face protecting helm recipe
R12 Casting
Felt x20
Leather Cord x10
Improved Steel Sheet x5

The helmet is unisex and cannot be color-customized.
